exposure: Sociodemographic factors (nationality, maternal education, employment, parity)
cohort: The study included 1,815 participating mothers with children below the age of 2 in the UAE.
finding: Non-Emirati nationality and vaginal birth were significantly associated with higher breastfeeding initiation rates, timely initiation, and longer durations of both overall and exclusive breastfeeding.
mod_finding: Vaginal birth was significantly associated with higher breastfeeding initiation rates, timely initiation, longer overall breastfeeding duration, and longer exclusive breastfeeding duration.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from mothers with children under two years old at a single point in time.
